## Design Settings » Homepage » Select Content to Display » Homepage Hero Divider
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000098293

## Homepage Hero Divider
This article goes over the available settings to edit the Hero Divider section on the homepage of the website. To edit this section navigate to:
Settings
Design Settings
Select Content to Display
Homepage Hero Divider
This section is meant to be displayed on the homepage exclusively.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12138325235/original/fLCNp87Rh1jgVeRHHByN5-2uIppfVjSXmQ.png?1707235091 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12138325330/original/Eo3gm-Gi0JVXqaG9-Tsnjq59BgyCk9EH6w.png?1707235156 | alt: ]

## Visual Guide of the Homepage Hero Divider Settings
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12138325604/original/86wdKJSGWVZZQrr9cbXJ-i68cVaOipGnQQ.png?1707235397 | alt: ]

## 1. Icon Or Image
This setting controls if this section will display an image or if an icon is going to be used instead.

## Icon
This will set the icon for the logo
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12138326206/original/M9y4VWxpXFzp5RjO6NmegtjaV69r4o3_wg.png?1707235786 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12138326289/original/4HKQk-57iWvtyU_QU8usO9ZPl7wP95XIjw.png?1707235807 | alt: ]

## Image
This will set the image that will be used instead of the logo icon and slogan.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12138327936/original/95qgkcDm9ILELoqk1th1fBWWyP9Mx8hRHw.png?1707236948 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12138326671/original/WjkXHNZT3kEFWL1RrYRtBENbVe32MQLgFQ.png?1707236024 | alt: ]

## 2. Hide On Mobile?
This setting controls if this section will be displayed on mobile devices or not.

## No
This will show the section on mobile devices.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12138328026/original/PVcaOJDN3cAMOi1RlHMYnWkwbBhhMgOMqQ.png?1707237037 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12138328124/original/J_JXIzBVYFI9W-06In2boOmE6IP8lf-lTQ.png?1707237117 | alt: ]

## Yes
This will hide the section on mobile devices
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12138328026/original/PVcaOJDN3cAMOi1RlHMYnWkwbBhhMgOMqQ.png?1707237037 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12138328243/original/16tTF83w8IODgHjA3YRQJsu_lzywP7iq0g.png?1707237222 | alt: ]

## 3. Icon Image 1
This setting controls the first icon on the section, click the image of the icon to view the available options.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12138328559/original/lqAjuk8EeAjtyvnCcbUhHlbIQY_RlEJRvQ.png?1707237526 | alt: ]

## 4. 1 - Title
This setting controls the first title on the section.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12138328800/original/H-99HKrOgqmnRHpgQ4TLBgqil8D4sfV1bg.png?1707237711 | alt: ]

## 5. 1 - Caption
This setting controls the first Caption on the section. The variable used in this section is custom_117
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12138329379/original/ZUGx1u44w7QmSeKIuyrxNKI0rUkvEUCP-w.png?1707238297 | alt: ]

## 6. 1 - Link Text
This setting controls the first Link Text on the section. If the link needs to open in a new tab, make sure to select the option "Open New Tab "
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12138329242/original/AqnXC0wb8X3V0AFOu7fla7-I3mA5zyCQfQ.png?1707238215 | alt: ]

This setting controls the first Link Text on the section. If the link needs to open in a new tab, make sure to select the option "Open New Tab "
